rf_supply.detail: Company website states global business in 85 countries including 'Asian & CIS countries' (https://www.umedicalabs.com/). This is a self-declaration only — no named CIS/Russia counterparty, contract, customs record or B/L found. No evidence of actual supplies to Russia or CIS located.

note: RISK-ONLY REVIEW. Sanctions: no match found for 'Umedica Laboratories' on OFAC SDN/Non-SDN consolidated lists (checked via https://sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov/ — the tool is JS-driven and returned no records for the name; SDN list last updated 23.11.2026). UN, EU, UK OFSI and BIS Entity List were NOT independently queried — search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was down throughout this session ('Connection refused'), so only Bing and direct URL fetches worked; treat non-sanctions findings as unverified-negative rather than confirmed clean. Court cases: two live cross-suits at Bombay High Court with Crescent Pharma Limited (2026) — a commercial/contractual dispute, not a criminal matter; plus two concluded customs/excise tax appeals (1990, 2017). Per project rule 2 these are noted neutrally and are NOT rejection grounds. Regulator actions: no US FDA warning letter, Form 483, recall or import alert surfaced in Bing results; the FDA warning-letter search URL returned HTTP 404 so the FDA database was not directly queried — status unknown, not confirmed clean. Credit rating: null — no CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings action found in available search results; not public in sources reachable today. Negative news: null — nothing found, but search coverage was degraded. RF/CIS supply: website claims CIS presence; no documentary evidence of actual Russia/CIS shipments found — recorded as 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Note the declared industry ('Продукты питания и FMCG') does not match the company's actual business (pharmaceutical formulations manufacturer, founded 1982, Turbhe/Vapi facilities) — flagged for the HS/identity team, not assessed here. Overall: no rejection grounds under project rules; residual uncertainty due to search-tool outage.
